reason: SideNavSection renders a labelled role="group" wrapper -- its heading and aria-labelledby name the group for assistive technology -- but carries no interactive affordance of its own. Every control inside it belongs to a child component: a SideNavItem's link or button, or a nested collapsible's own trigger. Binding a control pattern here would claim an affordance that lives one level down instead. What this layer adds beyond React's own binding is where the group lives: the host IS the group, because an Angular primitive host-binds its root, where React renders a wrapper div inside its own return.
